desc: Derive the mandatory and temporary flip model and the optimal ordering: removals descending by weight, activations ascending by weight.
Verify via exchange arguments that, for a fixed temporary set, all removals precede all activations and the stated sorted orders are optimal.
Prove that selecting the largest persistent weights for each temporary-set size is optimal.
Fix the activation-sequence insertion formula by removing the spurious `+1`.
Run all provided samples and confirm the corrected \(O(N\log N)\) implementation and safe integer arithmetic.
